The ''''It Howls In The Rain'''' is a decorative piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall.  It can be won in the Crane Game inside the [[Movie Theater]], during {{season|fall}}, when the movie "It Howls In The Rain" is playing in the Movie Theater.

This poster is displayed outside the [[Movie Theater]] while the movie is playing, and the season before it's featured.
